name: skye-spectacle-design-registry
purpose: Pattern registry for premium Skye/Spectacle web generation through MCP.
forbiddenPatterns: Disconnected logo/image beside unrelated hero copy
Internal build/debug/test output on public pages
Card grid as the core first impression
Hero subject accidentally below the first mobile viewport
Repeated dark SaaS/card-dashboard template with only copy changed
Rounded-square initial badge or CSS logo tile used instead of an existing logo asset
CSS-only screenshot fade described as an animated video
Static landing-page screenshot called proof for an app workflow
Ignoring requested Framer Motion, Three.js, screenshot, cursor, neon text, or scrollbar effects
qualityGates: Main subject visible in first viewport
No internal proof/debug wording in public copy
design_stack_audit passes when advanced stack is required
design_performance_audit passes when advanced motion, WebGL, screenshots, or scroll effects are used
Visual output is distinct from the last generated page
Requested cursor, scrollbar, screenshot, and text effects are visible in browser
design_logo_audit passes when a logo, wordmark, nav brand, or brand mark appears
Animated workflow proof is a real browser-action MP4/WebM when Playwright/ffmpeg are available
design_e2e_proof_audit passes when copy claims signup, auth, routing, restore, monitoring, deploy, filtering, handoff, or other app behavior
Founder-built product copy uses first-person operator/company voice

effectStandards.framerMotion: Use framer-motion when requested by name; motion/react is acceptable only when that is the project standard.
effectStandards.surfaceScreenshots: Use actual screenshots of product/app/site surfaces when they are the strongest proof subject. If workflow proof is requested or copy says the app does XYZ, record the browser doing XYZ, encode a real MP4/WebM reel with Playwright/ffmpeg, run design_e2e_proof_audit, and verify playback.
effectStandards.textEffects: Glow, neon, shimmer, split-line, and chromatic text effects are allowed when they support hierarchy.
effectStandards.cursorTrail: Pointer-reactive cursor trail is allowed on premium desktop experiences with fallback on mobile.
effectStandards.scrollbar: Scroll-led pages should use a thicker visible branded scrollbar with a slightly opaque track and neon thumb highlights when requested.

logoStandards.rule: Use approved logo, mark, emblem, and wordmark assets before generating a new mark.
reject: Text-only initials in rounded gradient boxes
CSS-generated brand marks pretending to be finished logos
Random shields, cubes, sparks, or circuit icons not present in the logo manifest
Replacing a transparent/floating logo asset with a generic badge

contentStandards.firstPersonOperatorVoice: Founder-built systems should use Gray's first-person builder/operator/company POV: I built, I use, I route, I show, I keep, plus we/our when referring to brains, agents, networks, gates, proof layers, and the company machine.
reject: Generic agency voice: we help, our solutions, best-in-class, innovative solutions
Neutral platform copy when the public page should feel personally built
Vague benefits without concrete rooms, gates, receipts, command decks, workspaces, or operating brains

advancedStackGate.rule: If a brief requires Motion, GSAP, Lenis, Three, R3F, Drei, or postprocessing, generated source must import and use those tools.
reject: Copy says Three.js, GSAP, Lenis, or motion but source does not import it
Static card/dashboard template used where a living scene or scroll funnel was requested

performanceGate.rule: Advanced motion must feel crisp: explicit Lenis tuning, capped WebGL DPR, capped particles, lazy decoded screenshots, and mobile/reduced-motion fallbacks.
reject: Large particle counts without compact/mobile reduction
Below-fold screenshots without loading="lazy" and decoding="async"
Cursor trails, fixed overlays, or scroll scenes without mobile/reduced-motion fallback

typography.displaySerif: Playfair Display or high-contrast editorial serif
typography.label: Bebas Neue or compact uppercase display
typography.body: DM Sans or clean system sans

designVarietySystem.rule: Do not treat SkyeSol spectacle as the only look. Choose a distinct design DNA before implementation.
antiSamenessGate: Reject if the new page repeats the prior hero structure, palette, proof layout, and card rhythm.
Reject if SkyeSol living background is the entire visual idea.
Reject if all products become dark command-card dashboards.
Require a chosen archetype from design_variety_plan before coding.

patterns.name: Full Width Command Hero
patterns.useWhen: The product needs a premium first impression with a direct title across the page.
rules: Headline spans the composition, not a skinny left column
Short support line sits below or beside CTA
Visual scene supports the title rather than competing with it
No paragraph stack in first viewport

patterns.name: Cinematic Object Scene
patterns.useWhen: The product can be represented as a 3D object, command chamber, proof artifact, dashboard, founder portrait, or operational symbol.
rules: One subject dominates
Motion is subtle and high-quality
Mobile keeps the subject visible
Scene supports product understanding

patterns.name: Scrolling Proof Funnel
patterns.useWhen: A buyer needs to understand a process: signup, setup, proof, handoff, payment, access.
rules: Each scroll stage has one job
Pinned motion only when it clarifies
Proof is client-safe and concise
No raw logs on public pages

patterns.name: Founder Authority Scene
patterns.useWhen: A founder/operator identity is central to trust.
rules: Use transparent founder media unboxed when possible
Pair with proof metrics
Use editorial headings
Avoid over-carded layouts

patterns.name: App First Surface
patterns.useWhen: The deliverable is a tool/app, not a brochure.
rules: Show the actual working surface first
Use toolbars, tabs, controls, and status indicators
Do not make a fake marketing hero
Prioritize usefulness over decoration

patterns.name: Editorial Proof Atlas
patterns.useWhen: The page needs proof, receipts, screenshots, and trust evidence presented with magazine-level hierarchy.
rules: Use a light or warm palette when the last page was dark
Lead with one large proof/media subject
Keep evidence sparse and readable
No repeated dashboard/card rhythm

patterns.name: Spatial Product Lab
patterns.useWhen: The product can be inspected like an object or system core.
rules: Use one WebGL product object
Pair with controls/spec chips
Avoid generic SaaS metrics cards
Use a palette distinct from the previous surface

patterns.name: Kinetic Process Funnel
patterns.useWhen: The conversion story is a sequence: intake, gate, provision, proof, handoff.
rules: Each stage gets a full section
Use GSAP/Lenis only to clarify progression
One action per stage
Mobile must remain scrollable and readable
